items.text: Restart Ghoztty and Background Sessions now really ends your running sessions.
A viewer's worktree poll no longer queues behind its own lookup.
job-escape-startup's flaky section B is green 10 of 10 now, and a red B says why its log is empty.
A pane that "died silently" was killed from outside, and the crash report now names that exit code.
The dashboard launcher no longer hangs a script that captures its output.
A user-report close no longer cuts a second, empty release when the release that carries its fix has already gone out.
T1651 closed as superseded: the due sweep's real cost is its serial exclusive tail.
The task dashboard's poll drops from 13.7 MB to 603 KB on the wire.
